svg.title: Approach to equilibrium: rates
svg.desc: Forward and reverse reaction rates against time. The forward rate falls and the reverse rate rises until the two meet at a common value and stay there. Equal rates, not zero rates, is what equilibrium means. Illustrative data.
svg.text: Forward and reverse rates converge and become equal (figure 2 of 2)
Equal rates, not zero rates: both processes continue.
